subject.title: [Feature]: Support direct video upload to LLM

question: Should OpenClaw add native direct video upload for chat now, and what provider capability, fallback, retention, and raw-media egress policy should that contract use?
rationale: The remaining work is not a narrow bug fix; it changes UI acceptance, Gateway attachment semantics, provider/model routing, raw user-media egress, and fallback behavior.

options.title: Approve a shared video-upload contract
options.body: Define the typed video content/fallback contract and require the implementation PR to preserve provider auth/transport controls, explicit size/retention limits, docs, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Limit to media-understanding tools first
options.body: Keep direct chat uploads blocked for now and improve the existing video.description/media-understanding path until provider-native chat video policy is ready.

options.title: Defer direct video upload
options.body: Leave the request open but pause implementation until raw video egress and provider capability policy are settled through a broader design review.

recommendation.title: Approve a shared video-upload contract
recommendation.body: Define the typed video content/fallback contract and require the implementation PR to preserve provider auth/transport controls, explicit size/retention limits, docs, and real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history across media-understanding contracts, model/provider boundaries, and prior routing comments on this exact feature.
